text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa defeated Silence Suzuka. 
This time she didn't collapse after the 
goal, standing firmly upon the ground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While praising her victory,
Silence Suzuka 
told El Condor Pasa that she has a
special 
talent for turning the fans' cheers into 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However,
El Condor Pasa wonders if drawing 
strength from the fans isn't something 
that applies to every Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pondering the meaning behind Silence 
Suzuka's words, El Condor Pasa sets her 
sights on her cherished goal, the Japan 
Cup.
